Regular Appearances & Appellate Forums

The chamber provides formal presentation and drafting services across key judicial institutions in the National Capital Territory and higher appellate benches nationwide.

FORUM I

Supreme Court of India

Special Leave Petitions (SLPs), Civil and Criminal Appeals, and Article 32 Original Writ Petitions.

FORUM II

High Court of Delhi

Original Civil Jurisdiction, Commercial Appellate Bench, Writ Petitions under Article 226, and Section 482 CrPC matters.

FORUM III

National Company Law Appellate Tribunal

Statutory corporate insolvency proceedings (IBC, 2016) and appellate corporate litigation before NCLT / NCLAT.

FORUM IV

Arbitral Tribunals

Domestic and international commercial arbitrations seated under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.

account_balance Informational Compendium

Fields of Practice

Descriptive overview of substantive branches of Indian jurisprudence routinely handled by the chambers. Listed for purely informational purposes.

01 • WRIT JURISDICTION policy

Constitutional & Writ Law

Challenging administrative overreach, defending fundamental rights, and asserting statutory rights under Articles 32 and 226 of the Constitution of India.

Statutory Framework → Constitution of India
02 • COMMERCIAL LITIGATION corporate_fare

Corporate & Commercial Disputes

Litigation arising out of shareholder agreements, joint venture dissolutions, injunction suits, and breach of contractual covenants under the Commercial Courts Act, 2015.

Statutory Framework → Companies Act, 2013
03 • PROPERTY & TRUSTS foundation

Civil Litigation & Real Property

Complex title disputes, partition proceedings, specific performance of real estate contracts, and testamentary probate matters before civil and appellate courts.

Statutory Framework → CPC, 1908 • TPA, 1882
04 • CRIMINAL DEFENSE shield

Criminal Jurisprudence & Appellate Defense

Representation in white-collar economic offences (PMLA, PC Act, SFIO inquiries), regular and anticipatory bails, revisions, and appeals before appellate benches.

Statutory Framework → BNSS • BNS • PMLA
05 • ADR & MEDIATION handshake

Arbitration & Dispute Resolution

Appointment of arbitrators under Section 11, interim protection applications under Section 9, and enforcement or challenge of arbitral awards under Section 34/37.

Statutory Framework → Arbitration Act, 1996
06 • RESTRUCTURING account_balance_wallet

Banking & Insolvency (IBC)

Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) advisory, creditor representation, liquidation procedures, and recovery actions under the SARFAESI Act before DRT / DRAT.

Statutory Framework → IBC, 2016 • SARFAESI
